issues.problem: ne-agreement mistake 1 (私の誕生日は五月ですね) is not clearly wrong: ですね is common in a hesitant answer (えーと、五月ですね).
issues.action: Replaced with an unambiguous warning case: 後ろから車が来ていますね → よ, with the context that the friend has not noticed.

issues.problem: ne-agreement explain left out the think-aloud ですね exception, which learners hear all the time and which contradicts the 'new information never takes ね' rule as written.
issues.action: Added one sentence on the hesitant-answer exception (explain is still under 900 characters).

issues.problem: yo-assertion mistake 2 context (相手が食べている時) was underspecified: if only the listener is eating, the speaker cannot share the taste, so ね is not the clear fix.
issues.action: Changed the context to 二人で同じ料理を食べて and reworded the note to match.
